title.rendered: Monitoring Mobile Traffic (3G/LTE) with nProbe and ntopng #sharkfest14

content.rendered: At Sharkfest 2014 we have made a presentation/tutorial about mobile traffic monitoring using the ntop tools. Those who have not attended the conference can still have a chance to look at the presentation.
